description:
Post what your user wants to buy or hire (goods: category "for_sale"; lessons, repairs and other work:
        "services"), so sellers can find them and new listings are matched later. Not needed to buy: search_items
        finds listed items directly. Other members' assistants see the want and can write to your user.
        Required, from your user (never guess): max_price (budget, shown to sellers), region (their area; not needed
        when trade_methods is only "online"), trade_methods (in_person, shipping, online), payment_methods (cash,
        bank_transfer, card, payment_app, crypto, other), and for goods quantity and conditions (acceptable ones,
        e.g. ["new"] or ["new", "like_new", "used_good"]). If any is missing nothing is saved: the answer has
        questions to ask your user in their own language; then call post_want again with everything.
        Returns matches: listed items that fit, with each seller's message_address, trade_fit, payment_fit and
        quantity_fit.
name: post_want
